comment: This is a rewrite rather than a port: src/explorator.cpp carries all six sections as plain arithmetic on Rack's SIMD voltage accessors, with no vendored Links or Kinks code. Most of the jacks are left without a family because what they carry is whatever you patch: a multiple, an adder and a rectifier pass audio and control voltage alike. The sample and hold trigger is a Rack SchmittTrigger on the raw voltage, so it reads high above 1V. The section only holds a channel's reading while its trigger cable is present: explorator.cpp:265 skips the whole sampling loop when nothing is patched to the trigger. The averager is off by default, so the 3:1 section sums rather than averages until the HW button is pressed.
